description: Emergency red-flag rules — escalate when symptom combinations indicate serious conditions

rules.message: Chest pain can be a sign of a heart attack or other serious condition.
rules.action: Call emergency services or go to the nearest hospital immediately.

rules.message: Difficulty breathing requires immediate medical evaluation.
rules.action: Go to the nearest emergency department.

rules.message: Heart palpitations with chest pain require immediate evaluation.
rules.action: Go to the nearest emergency department.

rules.message: Confusion or disorientation can indicate a serious medical condition.
Blood in urine can indicate a serious underlying condition.
rules.action: Visit a healthcare professional within 24 hours.

rules.message: Chest pain with breathing difficulty is a medical emergency.
Vomiting with diarrhea can lead to dehydration, especially in children and the elderly.
rules.action: Seek medical attention if you cannot keep fluids down for more than 24 hours.
